fusions.name: Switchblade Cuff
fusions.desc: A weapon strike with spring blades that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sprung on the Limping
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A pounce that deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Padded Servos
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Ninth Backup
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
